entries.exact: Discovery permission retained a pre-release certification requirement

Document 820 modifies the protective order governing discovery provided by the prosecution to Maxwell’s defense. It permits disclosures required by the Act while preserving restrictions for protected victim information. Before covered discovery is released, the United States Attorney for SDNY must personally certify in a sworn declaration filed in the case that the records were rigorously reviewed for compliance with Section 2(c)(1)(A) and that none of the records to be released contains the protected victim information specified there; the review must include at least one SDNY USAO attorney. The order also directs DOJ to distinguish Maxwell grand-jury materials from discovery covered by the protective order when making them public.
